decisions: Accepted refuter findings C01-C12, C14-C25 and F01-F23 (C13 and F20 only in part, see open_points). Each citation was checked against the files, and every change was applied to CONTRACT.md and the specs that use it.

No kills (decision 29). stop.mjs verify reports survivors and kills nothing. handover raise kills nothing and reports stale_wake_sources. A new alarm leaves the old one to exit 0 `superseded`. proc.kill is gone from lib. The one kill is lib.killOwnTree: selftest only, leaf-first, never /T, absolute taskkill path.

stop verify never sleeps (decision 30). The first call writes run/stop-sample and exits 6 `sampling`. Later calls exit 6 `waiting` until stop_verify_deltas watcher ticks have passed, then compare. The `--interval-ms` flag is removed.
Host classification compares boot identifiers (decision 31). lib proc gains boot(); edgeFacts returns {now, freeMb, boot}; `--boot` replaces `--uptime-s` everywhere; bootTimeIso is removed.

Tainted audit: commit record exits 1 `tainted`. Fence reason `tainted` counts like a stall, and a READY never wins over it. commit record also needs an audit line newer than the last intake line, else exit 6 `audit-missing`. status `next` gains `audit` (decision 32).

R47 pilot capacity check in commit record for pack steps: `pack-over-capacity` (canonical bytes / 4 above W_quality - child_prefix_tokens - review_reserve_tokens, unless the pack has an index) and `confirmed-card-cut` (decision 33). Intake also checks `questions-sha`.

Watcher events are keyed by condition onset: key `<class>|<task>|<epoch>|<onset_tick>`, with an `active` map in watcher.json (decision 34). Class 27 comes from verifyLedger or a tamper incident line; class 10 comes from a tms check line with a `reopened` reason. In intake, step exits 1/6/10 write no incident, 2/70 write one, and 64/3 end intake. Transcripts are parsed incrementally (per-file parse-state) with no lock held. Class 14 uses lib.intakeCandidates.

Gate action lines are only params that carry `line: {measure, op}` (decision 35). gate.json carries schema_version and nullable shas. The current design (cut, stpa/fmea/hazards) is chosen by highest commit ledger seq via lib.currentDesign, used by gate, render, admit and replace.

`unverifiable` is exit 2 in snap and witness (decision 36). snap's address filter is a net.BlockList with NAT64, 6to4, IPv4-mapped and reserved ranges, and each request gets its own Agent with a pinned lookup.

R18 flag clearing: lib.flagCleared needs a confirmed sentence-check line with check.node, from a batch whose queue line is newer than the flag, with no later unqualified-revert of one of its classes. That last clause is a new edit in §3.15. check-queue keys carry `node`. promote writes `sentence-check` / `sentence-unqualified` lines with `classes`. Revert is by class membership. promote ledger data gains mode/class. Verdicts go through lib.checkerVerdicts.
B_tokens/r_tokens null is a reading, not a refusal (decision 39). briefs.md is updated to match, and its weights.out is 5 (render T14 token_cost is now 3950).

New lib functions: attemptOf, variant, currentDesign, currentProtocol, questionsSha, runFlags, intakeCandidates, flagCleared, checkerVerdicts, readSetSha, walkFiles, removeTree, segmentName, urlKey, recordIncident, thresholds.line. lib.md gains tests for each, plus EPERM retry, BOM/UTF-16, the junction staging cut, turnEnds, the lastCall merge, 1 MiB chunked parse, start_time format, descendants ordering and the slot rule.

Windows hardening: segmentName folds `.claude.`, `CLAUDE.md.` and `Claude.MD` in guard-hook, fsck and audit. `.git/` is added to protected paths. fsck runs git with hardened -c flags and a 60 s timeout. fsck gains check 9 (frozen and cut files hash to their names), witness-ledger tying, and agent-file acceptance.

guard-hook's witnessed-fetch check reads only {attempt}/in/must_read.json plus the URL's by-url file and meta, never the ledger. The settings command starts with the quoted `{node}`. The coordinator's write_prefixes are the §2.1 plan paths including plan/notes/.

handover init creates the empty tasks table, .gitattributes (`* -text`) and the extended .gitignore. A root longer than 40 characters gets a `root-long` warning, not a refusal. A §2.1 writer row is added for .gitignore/.gitattributes.

selftest: case roots are `<root>/tmp/st-<nonce8>/<n>/`. The tcb copy excludes fixtures/test. Each case gets its own transcripts_root. A static check `watch-case-loops` is added. --jobs is capped by free memory. Timeouts use killOwnTree. The canary subject is `canary:<session>`. expect.code matches any reasons[].code; CONTRACT §1.3 is reworded to say the same.

cost from-transcripts parses before the lock and appends a `unit-costs` ledger line. protocol-freeze checks `arm-tasks` (with `<task>.<step>`). compare and render take the current analysis plan from the last plan-freeze or protocol-amend line named analysis-plan. fsck counts protocol-amend files too.

Final cross-check fixes in CONTRACT.md: §5 exit column gains 3 for watch, check-queue, protocol-freeze, compare, gate and render, and 2 for handover. §2.1 uses the names lib.acquireLock and cost `from-transcripts`. The by-url file is named `<urlKey>`, not `<urlsha>`. replace's must_read.json carries schema_version. A scripted check confirmed every threshold name the specs read is in the §3.20 table. A grep confirmed no CR-, uptime, interval-ms, mustInclude, proc.kill, bootTimeIso, url_sha or `<task>:<step>` remains.
open_points: Rejected (C13, the memory part): no memory-park from active/stopped. A stopped row holds no process, so it holds no memory. Only the cut/drop no-attempt path was accepted.

Rejected (F01 machinery): no `stop_kill` option or kill threshold. Stop stays report-only until needs-app 4 shows a session's processes can be identified by more than a command-line substring (decision 29).
Rejected: requiring a canary line before admission. It needs a real session (needs-app 11), and admission would block in every test root.
Rejected: B/r null as a refusal (the briefs owner's note). R45 says a null threshold is a reading (decision 39).
Rejected: R48(a), predicted-vs-realised t_q, as a watcher pilot item. It is a post-run comparison from cost/compare, not a wake class.
Partial (F20): the root length is a warning (`root-long`), not a refusal, plus the 100-character project-folder prefix fallback in transcriptsForFolder. Tests use long temp roots.

Open (CR-16): the canary-denies role, a folder without the hook used to test user-level denies alone, and its probe list are not defined. This is needs-app and is noted in selftest's needs-app section.
Open: the hook's `agent_type` field for helpers is believed, not measured (needs-app 1).

Follow-up for U5c (I cannot edit it): tcb/thresholds.json must rename audit_coord_turn_factor to coord_over_factor (1.5). It must add stop_verify_deltas 2, lean_tolerance_tokens null, child_prefix_tokens 60000, review_reserve_tokens 75000, fetch_max_redirects 5, hook_deadline_ms 5000, selftest_case_ms 60000, sleep_gap_ms 600000, lock_retries 300, proc_exe (absolute powershell path) and user_files. It must add `.git/` to tcb_paths_protected, set weights.out 5, and add `line` to unverifiable_share_max ({measure: unverifiable_share, op: max}) and coverage_floor ({measure: coverage, op: floor}). briefs.md T14-T16 now test exactly this.

Follow-up for U5c: the reader brief's result schema must be the [reader-result] {schema_version: 1, cards, skipped}, with each card carrying schema_version. harvest treats an object without schema_version as unparseable.

Follow-up for U3b/U5a, found in the final cross-check and not changed: the coordinator profile's agent_types is `checker, mapper`. mapper is a design-check session role, not a helper. Meanwhile the scorer (compare.mjs, briefs) is a coordinator-started helper with no profile, settings or agent file in §3.21. My suggestion: agent_types `checker, scorer`, a `scorer` profile (Read on {root}/views/blind/), and `tcb/agents/scorer.md`. This needs the U3b owner's agreement.

Note: the new R18 clause (a later unqualified-revert of a class in the clearing line's `classes` reopens the flag) was added to CONTRACT §3.15 so a J-class losing qualification cannot leave a sentence certified. tms and certify get it through lib.flagCleared without spec changes.

Note: lib T21b/T25b test Windows sharing retries through an injected fs seam, because Node opens files with delete sharing and cannot hold a file the way an antivirus scanner does. The real behaviour stays a pilot observation.
